title: Order the Grader
story: The report-card program fell apart. Rebuild it so that 95 gives A, 80 gives B and 10 gives C.
goal: Put the lines in order so the program grades correctly.
hints: if comes first, then elif, then else. Indentation shows which line belongs to which branch.
The highest score check must come before the lower one.
socratic: What must come before elif and else?
Why must the 90 check come before the 75 check?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what decides the order of these lines?
